name: Necromancer
blurb: Raises a skeleton every 4s. Each fallen minion powers up Soul Drain, which hits everyone.

sfx.summon: bones rattling as a skeleton rises

music: dark spooky chiptune battle loop, 135 bpm, no vocals

art.floor: dry grey-brown graveyard dirt with tiny scattered white bones, a uniform repeating texture with no plants
art.body: a creepy necromancer: a perfectly round dusty purple ball body under a ragged dark purple hood, a bone-white skull face with glowing green eye sockets and a row of skull teeth
weapons: a long dark wooden scythe with a pale glowing green curved blade at the right end, curving downward

summons.skeleton: a small skeleton warrior: a round bone-white skull ball body with dark eye sockets and a toothy grin

summon_weapons.skeleton: a small rusty iron short sword with a bone handle

art.ultimate_icon: a green ghostly soul wisp with a skull face
art.ult_circle: a sinister green necromantic summoning circle with a skull in the center and bone runes
art.ult_aura: a swirling sickly green ghost-fire aura with wailing spirit faces
art.hit_fx: a green soul wisp splash with tiny skull-shaped sparks
